members.label: 2-XM
members.differences: Behringer's copy of the Two Voice in a Eurorack case, without the keyboard: two SEM voices, each with two oscillators, a multimode filter and two ADS envelopes. A mixer places the two voices in the stereo field, a CV and gate patch field is added, and MIDI and USB play them split, layered or in unison.

members.label: Two Voice
members.differences: The original, Oberheim's 1975 pairing of two SEMs in one case with a keyboard and a small sequencer, each voice playable on its own: one of the first instruments to play two notes at once.
